s: To whom were the Kakatiyas feudatories before establishing their independent kingdom?
x:
The early Kakatiyas first served as feudatories of the Rashtrakutas. After the decline of the Rashtrakutas, they became vassals of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyani. Later rulers such as Prola II and Rudradeva (Prataparudra I) asserted independence and laid the foundation for the powerful Kakatiya kingdom with Orugallu (Warangal) as its capital.
Thus, the Kakatiyas rose gradually from feudatories to one of the greatest dynasties of medieval Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
